academic.researchIntro: I develop atomic-precision design rules and AI-enabled closed-loop synthesis for molecule-like metal nanoclusters, with the goal of making nanomaterial formation more predictable, interpretable, and programmable.

topics.title: Atomically Precise Metal Nanoclusters
topics.text: Molecule-like nanomaterials with resolved composition, structure, and surface chemistry.

topics.title: Smart Synthesis
topics.text: Reaction design and ligand programming that make formation pathways more controllable.

topics.title: Mass Spectrometry
topics.text: Analytical windows into intermediates, evolution, and precise cluster composition.

topics.title: AI for Materials
topics.text: Data-guided planning and closed-loop reasoning for synthesis and structure discovery.
